verdict.rationale: Mistral's own marketing says Document AI supports secure on-premises deployment, and the OCR 4 announcement says the model fits on a single container so document data stays in your environment. This is first-party self-hosting, but only as positioning: there is no deployment guide, no stated availability terms (it appears enterprise-sales gated), and no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented self-hosting/installation instructions, clarity on licensing and availability to non-enterprise users, independent or hands-on confirmation of on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
